description: A companion in a fight sets its drones on a rat it has locked, and the order is confirmed. The boss undocks and the companion follows it out; rats are spawned on the companion; the page locks the first of them. The server sends the drones' new target with its next tick, after CmdEngage has answered, so a page that reads the drones only once straight after the order finds them still on no target and calls the order unconfirmed (issue 177).
